lounges.name: China Southern Domestic Lounge 1 (First / Business)
lounges.location: Domestic departures, level 3 west side of the central area, beyond the premium security checkpoint.

hours.note: 04:30 until the final departure, according to China Southern and its booking partner. Confirm closing against the day’s flights.

Plaza Premium · China Southern No. 1 VIP Lounge

recommendation.summary: A meal and shower option for China Southern premium-cabin domestic departures.

lounges.note: Buffet service is 06:00–09:00, 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–20:00, with a separate cooked-food counter. Shower availability and charges should be checked at reception. Lounges 2 and 3 are separate facilities; their membership access is not assigned to this lounge.

lounges.name: China Southern International Lounge
lounges.location: International departures after border control and security, west side of the central terminal on levels 3 and 4.

hours.note: Until the last China Southern international departure. China Southern lists a 06:00 opening, while its booking partner lists 06:30; confirm access for an early visit.

Plaza Premium · China Southern International Lounge

qualityRating.summary: A 2024 review found comfortable seating and a quieter reading corner, but ordinary food and cramped shower rooms. A functional pre-flight stop; this older account is not a current service guarantee.

recommendation.summary: Buffet dining, showers and sleeping facilities for an international connection; ask reception about sleeping-room availability.

lounges.note: This is separate from the domestic China Southern lounges. No general SkyTeam entitlement is inferred. Access through partner-airline invitations and China Southern status is not yet covered by this guide.

lounges.name: CHUM VIP Lounge (Domestic)
lounges.location: Airside domestic departures, level 2, on the left near Gates A100–A105, following Priority Pass directions.

sources.title: Priority Pass · CHUM VIP Lounge at Gates A100–A105

recommendation.summary: A Priority Pass option for domestic departures near the A gates, with visits limited to three hours.

lounges.note: Priority Pass confirms complimentary massage chairs. Shower, dining and quiet-area details for this exact location remain unverified.

lounges.name: East Pacific Passenger Lounge (International)
lounges.location: After international security, take the lift to level 3 and follow the Pay Lounge signs; the booking partner locates it near Gate 1.

hours.note: Plaza Premium explicitly confirms 24-hour opening; Priority Pass displays the daily interval as 00:00–23:59.

sources.title: Priority Pass · East Pacific Passenger Lounge
Plaza Premium · East Pacific Passenger Lounge facilities and hours

qualityRating.summary: A September 2025 review found useful workspaces and a good rotating food selection, with morning crowding, limited drinks and busy bathrooms. A practical international stop rather than a standout lounge.

recommendation.summary: A 24-hour international Priority Pass option with showers and Wi-Fi; full meals are offered only at set times.

lounges.note: Meals are served 06:30–09:30, 11:00–13:30 and 17:00–19:30, with snacks outside these periods. Dining service style and a dedicated quiet area remain unverified. Confirm shower charges at reception. Priority Pass allows three hours; the separately sold Plaza Premium package describes two hours.
